evidence: Receiving DO online sensor: stable ~13-15 mg/L for 0-47 h
Receiving DO crash at t≈48 h: 12.26 → 4.95 mg/L
Continued decline to 3.11 mg/L at decision time 52 h, slope ≈ -0.5 mg/L/h
Keep extrapolates to DO < 2 mg/L within ~1.5-3 h
Source batches never showed this crash under KEEP, confirming source/receiving divergence
args.rationale: Receiving DO crashed at ~48 h and is still falling (~3.1 mg/L at 52 h, slope ≈ -0.5 mg/L/h). KEEP and milder interventions (air +15% or feed -20%) are predicted to breach the hard 2 mg/L DO limit. A 40% feed reduction plus 15% air increase is the least aggressive action with a predicted safety margin, retaining nonzero product mass unlike stop.
args.uncertainty: No physics model tool output was available; sufficiency of the 40%/15% intervention is inferred from observed DO dynamics. If oxygen demand escalates faster than the recent trend, even this plan could be marginal; continued DO monitoring and readiness to stop is advised.
